scope: Twenty-key reaction-picker delta: ui.teamBridge.reactions.* (add, search, categories, all, frequent, tone, toneDefault, empty, failed, category0-category8, choose, noResults). Inherit the base 2e16fb1456 full namespace audit for the other 109 values, all verified unchanged; no new full semantic audit of unchanged copy. Catalogue audit only, not rendered-fit, activation or release approval.

validation.independence: This auditor did not translate or edit any catalogue or code; repo worktree used read-only (no stage/commit/stash/checkout). Served as anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 throughout; no model switch or fallback observed.
validation.semantics: Read all 20 values against English, frozen context sidecar and the picker/reactions TSX usage. reaction -> प्रतिक्रिया (feminine; failed agrees: सहेजी नहीं गई) and emoji -> इमोजी are used consistently across the delta. search इमोजी खोजें matches टैग खोजें/फ़ाइलें खोजें; failed matches the locale's 'X सहेजी/सहेजे नहीं गई/गए। फिर कोशिश करें।' pattern (ui.teamBridge.notify.error, ui.chat.tags.save_failed); empty/noResults match 'कोई एजेंट नहीं मिला'; categories uses the locale's श्रेणियाँ. Polite imperative (जोड़ें, खोजें, चुनें, कोशिश करें), no तुम/तू. Category labels in Unicode group order are natural Hindi (खान-पान is an idiomatic compression of Food and drink; चिह्न for Symbols is an acceptable common rendering); hi CLDR characterLabels could not be fetched (network handshake failed) so exact CLDR-string identity is not claimed. toneDefault डिफ़ॉल्ट रंग omits त्वचा, accepted because it is the first option of the select labelled त्वचा का रंग beside toned 👍 options and the option is width-constrained. Nukta (डिफ़ॉल्ट) and chandrabindu plurals (श्रेणियाँ, भावनाएँ, गतिविधियाँ, वस्तुएँ) are consistent with the locale; danda only in the sentence-form failed value; labels carry no terminal punctuation, matching English.
validation.icu: Parsed each of the 20 actual values with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser via node (repo node_modules): every value is a single literal AST node with zero arguments; no {, }, <, > characters. All values NFC (v === v.normalize('NFC')); none contain U+200E/200F/202A-202E/2066-2069/061C or ZWJ/ZWNJ; no leading/trailing whitespace. Python flatten of en/hi/base: 129 en keys = 129 hi keys, no missing/extra; base 2e16fb1456 hi has 109 keys, all 109 byte-identical in target; the 20 new keys are exactly the scoped reactions delta.
validation.terminology: Glossary has no emoji/reaction row; style guide has no call for them. Within the delta, इमोजी and प्रतिक्रिया are each used for one English term without drift. Observation only, not a finding: ui.chat.response_actions.label (outside this namespace/delta) also uses प्रतिक्रिया for 'response'; the locale otherwise renders response as जवाब.
validation.overflow: Static code-point comparisons (en -> hi): add 12->18 (aria-label only), search 12->11, categories 16->15, all 9->9, frequent 15->21 (14 grapheme clusters; visible 12px heading sharing a flex justify-between row with the tone select in a w-80 picker - rendered check recommended), tone 9->12 (aria-label only), toneDefault 17->12 (visible narrow option, shorter), empty/noResults 14->19 (noResults in a full-width p-4 block, can wrap), failed 39->42 (inline alert, can wrap), category0-8 all <= English (tooltip/aria only), choose 15->11. No value is materially longer in a fixed-width visible slot except frequent, flagged for rendered check only, not a finding.
